import json,subprocess,sys,copy,ipaddress

base={'zones':[],'profiles':[{'id':'p','max_aliases':0,'cname':'follow','wildcard':'rfc'}],'queries':[],'observations':[]}
def run(raw):
 p=subprocess.run(MAIN,input=raw,capture_output=True,timeout=5)
 assert p.returncode==0 and not p.stderr,(p.returncode,p.stderr)
 try:r=json.loads(p.stdout)
 except:raise AssertionError(p.stdout)
 assert p.stdout.endswith(b'\n') and p.stdout.count(b'\n')==1
 return r
def inv(doc):
 raw=doc if isinstance(doc,bytes) else json.dumps(doc,separators=(',',':')).encode()
 r=run(raw);assert r=={'error':'invalid-input'},(doc,r)
def val(doc):
 r=run(json.dumps(doc,separators=(',',':')).encode());assert 'error' not in r,(doc,r)

for raw in [b'',b' ',b'{',b'null',b'[]',b'{}',b'\xff',b'\xef\xbb\xbf{}',b'{"zones":[],"profiles":[],"queries":[],"observations":[]} trailing',b'{"zones":[],"profiles":[],"queries":[],"observations":[],"x":NaN}',b'{"zones":[],"profiles":[],"queries":[],"observations":[],"x":1e999}']:

d=copy.deepcopy(base);d['zones']=[{'origin':'TEST.','records':[]},{'origin':'test.','records':[]}];inv(d)
